[EN] New Member of the Federation
[ES] Nuevo miembro de la Federación
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take care! May Kaia give you strength.
[ES] ¡Cuídate! Que Kaia te dé fuerza.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Rida at {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator} Command Center again.
[ES] Vuelve a hablar con Rida en el centro de mando de {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll think about it."
[ES] "Lo pensaré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Commander {@creature:528#5005$$Tamur} at {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator} Command Center. [Speak with {@linkcreature:84#1088$$Yunari} to enter the Kaiator Command Center.]
[ES] Habla con el comandante {@creature:528#5005$$Tamur} en el centro de mando de {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator}. [Habla con {@linkcreature:84#1088$$Yunari} para entrar al centro de mando de Kaiator.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I see. Okay, I accept."
[ES] "Ya veo. De acuerdo, acepto."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Discuss Tamur's condition with Rida.
[ES] Discute la condición de Tamur con Rida.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "As ordered."
[ES] "Como ordenes."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to {@creature:528#5005$$Tamur} at {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator} Command Center that you'll join the federation.
[ES] Informa al comandante {@creature:528#5005$$Tamur} en el centro de mando de {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator} que te unirás a la federación.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm on my way."
[ES] "Ya voy en camino."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with {@creature:528#5011$$Ukenul} at {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator} Command Center.
[ES] Habla con {@creature:528#5011$$Ukenul} en el centro de mando de {@Rgn:84001$$Kaiator}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Front of Kaiator Command Center
[ES] Frente al centro de mando de Kaiator
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Someone approaches.
[ES] Alguien se acerca.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go outside Headquarters to meet Kunar. [Speak with {@creature:528#5008$$Kamat} to go outside Headquarters.]
[ES] Sal del cuartel general para encontrarte con Kunar. [Habla con {@creature:528#5008$$Kamat} para salir del cuartel general.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sure. Okay."
[ES] "Claro. De acuerdo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hasmina calls you over. Speak with Hasmina.
[ES] Hasmina te llama. Habla con Hasmina.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Where Hasmina Went
[ES] A dónde fue Hasmina
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hasmina is waiting.
[ES] Hasmina está esperando.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow Hasmina.
[ES] Sigue a Hasmina.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Where Hasmina Went
[ES] A dónde fue Hasmina
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hasmina seems to be thinking deeply about something.
[ES] Hasmina parece estar pensando profundamente en algo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow Hasmina.
[ES] Sigue a Hasmina.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kaiator Transporation Hall
[ES] Sala de transporte de Kaiator
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You arrived at Kaiator Transporation Hall!
[ES] ¡Llegaste a la sala de transporte de Kaiator!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow Hasmina to the Kaiator Transporation Hall.
[ES] Sigue a Hasmina hasta la sala de transporte de Kaiator.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kaiator Transporation Hall
[ES] Sala de transporte de Kaiator
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You see the supplies ready.
[ES] Ves los suministros listos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow Hasmina to the Kaiator Transporation Hall.
[ES] Sigue a Hasmina hasta la sala de transporte de Kaiator.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Farewell."
[ES] "Adiós."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Hasmina at the Transporation Hall.
[ES] Habla con Hasmina en la sala de transporte.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Kunar and receive your supplies.
[ES] Habla con Kunar y recibe tus suministros.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
